raw_html: [[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Force Burst#Force Burst|Force Burst]]:''' This weapon is humming with magical force, and does 1 to 6 force damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 force damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
